items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: We come to have dinner and with the good, you know... friendship. And it was just thing, just like we were friends.

ctx.x: Well, when Wes was in the band, who was in it?

That was the bunch with Al Gray and Johnny Board and I can't think of all those guys' names, was in the band when Wes was there. Ah, Benny Powell, Earl Walker...Earl Fox Walker. I can't think of all the players that were in the band. But I do remember these two: Charlie Mingus was in the band, in Lionel Hampton's band...
